pro_course_detail.description:

The most important thing is that sales is about providing a solution to your customers' and clients' problems. It's not some sneaky way to trick or push people to do something they don't want to do. And I'll show you how to sell the right way.

In these sessions, we'll cover the following:
- how to build rapport with clients and customers
- how to ask the right questions to understand what your client/customer really wants and needs
- the right way to conduct a sales conversation
- how to present your offers and what not to do
- how to overcome objections and what to do if they say no
- specific language to use that triggers positive reactions and language to avoid
- how to nurture a lead when they're not ready to purchase yet
- and other tips and strategies to help you become confident and comfortable in sales

The things I teach come from over two decades of personal sales experience, as well as high-end training that I developed and taught to business professionals for over a decade. 

I can help you overcome the blocks and barriers that may be stopping you from being confident in sales so you can create more win/wins for yourself, your company, and your clients and customers.

pro_course_detail.title: Business Management, Leadership & Customer Service
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you a manager or team leader in your company or business? Do you have to work directly with customers and clients on a regular basis?

Leadership and customer service are all about communication. And not just any communication, but certain techniques based in psychology and knowing how to say things in a certain way.

I will help you become a better communicator so you customers that are happy and loyal and team members who are motivated and who respect you. 

In these sessions, we will cover:
- how to properly respond to an angry or upset customer to calm them down and show them that you want to help
- how to support your boss or other superiors to make them look good in front of customers/clients (which then makes you look good)
- specific language to use when asking questions to your subordinates - and especially what language to avoid and why
- language to use to motivate your team and get them to respect you vs. language that demotivates them and can cause you to lose their respect
- how to give positive and negative feedback to team members or good and bad reports to clients/customers in a way that it is well-received
- nonverbal language (body language) that puts people at ease and builds trust - and what  body/nonverbal language to avoid
- and many more tips, strategies, and language for your specific cases and scenarios

Having worked for many years as an entrepreneur, as well as in the corporate world, and with a background in psychology, human behavior, and communication, I am highly experienced in how to use language - both verbal and nonverbal - to build trust and rapport with clients/customers, teams, and students, to build loyalty and respect, and to motivate others to take action. Now, I'm happy to share my experience to help you!

pro_course_detail.title: Speak more like a native English speaker (Adults B1-C2) - Pronunciation, Common Expressions, Rhythm and more
pro_course_detail.description:
There are certain things that make it obvious that you're not a native English speaker. Pronunciation is only one small part of that.

In these sessions, I'll help you fully understand and improve all the areas that will help you speak more naturally like a native speaker.

We will cover:
- pronunciation (of course)
- common phrases, expressions & idioms (including what they mean, correct ways to say them, and appropriate times to use them + when not to use them)
- slang + which slang should not be used in a professional setting (you have to be careful with this)
- proper greetings + how to respond to different greetings
- appropriate greetings to use with your superiors vs. peers or subordinates (You want to be sure to get this right!)
- formal vs. informal language + appropriate times to use each one
- the correct rhythm of the English language + how it's different from your native language
- correct use of emphasis on words in a sentence to convey different meanings
- different ways to introduce yourself (or someone else) depending on if you're in person, on the phone, or via email
- correct use of prepositions, especially in/on/at (These can be confusing for non-native English speakers.)
- correct use of verb tenses (This is one of the biggest ways you can sound more natural right away.)
- how to properly pronounce letters when spelling words (and differences between British & American English)
- other differences between British & American English that you should know, especially depending on who you work with more often
- how to properly say numbers + how it's different depending on the type of number
- how to express units of measurement (like when to use things like carton, container, pack, package, etc.)
- and many more words, phrases, and ways to say things that will help you sound more natural when speaking

Having taught English for 14 years, I can quickly spot the areas you can improve to sound more natural. With my coaching, you will improve quickly.

pro_course_detail.title: Business Spanish B1-C2 ESPAÑOL (Adults)
pro_course_detail.description:

Las temáticas de la clase varían según las metas y objetivos del aprendiz, mas están pensadas para el mundo de los negocios, es decir, se enseñan una variante de herramientas comunicativas que son de gran utilidad al momento de negociar, plantear ideas, defender objetivos, establecer puntos de vista, convencer audiencias y terminologías exactas de varias temáticas (jurisprudencia, medicina, mediación, administración y etc...). El método presentado en la clase es una combinación de la propuesta de Blasti, Blasco y Cassany que como resultado presentan un español aplicado en la oratoria, el manejo correcto del lobby y una gramática específica según los fines planteados por el estudiante. 

Class designed for professionals with clear and effective objectives established by the client. The topics of the class vary according to the goals and objectives of the apprentice, but they are designed for the business world, that is, they teach a variant of communication tools that are very useful when negotiating, raising ideas, defending objectives, establishing points of view, convince audiences and exact terminologies on various topics (jurisprudence, medicine, mediation, administration, etc...). pro_course_detail.title: English for Work or Business
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn how to have a conversation about your work or business at a meeting, a conference, a cocktail party or a business lunch. You will learn and practice how to: 
1. Say what your work or business is, 
2. Ask about other people's work or business, establish rapport
3. Explain why you are at this meeting/conference/event/dinner
4. Ask questions that you want to ask
5. Understand the answers that you get
You will receive some materials that you can use to review your lesson later, learn and practice more.

pro_course_detail.description: I will work with you to take your English to the next level. You will learn to use English vocabulary and grammar to express your own ideas and thoughts, participate in conversations or write in English. I will help you develop strategies to improve your listening and reading, so that you can enjoy videos, audios, written texts and find information you need in English.

pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation and Resume Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you preparing for a job interview? Not sure how to answer tricky interview questions? Concerned about your grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation?

We will also design the best strategies for each of your difficult potential interview questions. You will practice your answers while I will give you detailed feedback and advise how you can do it better.  If the selection process requires you to write any texts, I will help you develop ideas, draft and edit your documents. 
I have helped people working in business, academia, government and international organisations  achieve their goals, and I am looking forward to helping you, too.

Are you excited to learn English in a fun and interactive way? In my experimental class, I will create a unique experience just for you! As a CELTA-trained tutor, I focus on your interests while making learning feel enjoyable.

What to Expect:

🎮 Gamified Learning: Experience English through games and challenges that match your hobbies and interests. Learning will feel like playtime!

🔍 Personalized Content: I will tailor activities specifically for you, making lessons enjoyable and relevant to your life.

🌐 Cultural Exploration: Discover new cultures while sharing your own. We’ll learn together!

In our class, I’ll use innovative methodologies tailored to your learning profile:

Project-Based Learning (PBL): Work on real-life projects that interest you, encouraging collaboration and problem-solving while practicing English in a meaningful context.

Engage-Study-Activate (ESA): Enjoy a dynamic approach that starts with fun activities, followed by focused language study, and ends with real-life practice to reinforce what you’ve learned.

Bilingualism: Embrace your native language alongside English to enhance understanding and boost your confidence.

Whether you’re a beginner or advanced and want to improve, my gamified classes are perfect for you. Let’s make learning English an exciting adventure together—sign up today!
